digest.component_or_area: ticket store ensure unit, marker cache self-healing
propositions: Runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD despite .gitignore patterns, causing routine marker churn to surface as tracked working-tree deletions that dirty git status and break store head-check validation
An ensure unit named untrack-runtime-markers must remove these markers from git index via git rm --cached in batches and commit exactly once, leaving worktree copies intact

Peers merging the untrack commit will have their worktree marker files deleted by git, but the reader must self-heal missing .archived markers by re-materializing them when compiled state indicates archived
The ensure unit check is one git ls-files call returning empty; the act phase executes batched git rm --cached (batch size 200) followed by one commit through the store seam
Self-healing in reducer._api.py list path must re-materialize missing .archived markers only for archived tickets in exclude_archived mode, mirroring existing stale-marker clearing logic
